evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/n/a/a/d as rs.interfaces.components.dropdown.DropDownOption.
Exact v308 class stores exactly two Strings, provides constructor/getters/setters, and implements value-style equals/hashCode/toString over both strings.
Dropdown interface code retrieves this type from the R283 DropDownComponent option list and mutates the two String surfaces for visible option text and extended difficulty/description text.
Exact packet/state code constructs DropDownOption(String,String) instances from decoded strings, replaces the component option list, and selects an option by its first String value.

candidates.note: Source-proven dropdown option value type. R407 proposes only the class identity, not field/member names.
